part.text:
Implemented B10 in `benchmark/conventional/`. Created tasks now return an `owner` string: omitted owners default to `""`, supplied owners are trimmed, and blank supplied values fail with `invalid_owner` without writing. `list-owner --owner` matches exactly and case-sensitively, including `""`.

The schema is now version 9. Migration adds an empty owner to older records and preserves version-8 `archived` values. I added regression tests for these behaviors; all 28 Conventional tests pass.
